reuse.reason: The pinned official AccountSection and SignInDialog use a Platform browser authorization attempt, not local Better Auth username/email/password authentication. Mounting or forking that flow retains the incompatible Platform account contract; the Models ApiKeyInput and SettingsSecretField manage provider credentials rather than local-account sign-in. This custom local-account plugin therefore owns only the account flow and composes unchanged Modal, Button, Input and icons from the stable ui-primitives export. The default official Modal header, description, close control, mask, focus lifecycle and theme tokens provide the presentation; local CSS only arranges the flow and semantic messages. The existing reviewed theme presenter supports standalone /login. Authentication policy is enforced by the Worker.
gaps: This revision limits the workbench to authenticated accounts. The anonymous homepage uses the isolated sign-in and consent document providers.
